input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding us. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, or conducting business in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity or non-compete commitment has been made; § 2.1 likewise confirms no minimum purchase commitment. The only competition restriction (12.4) binds Vendor, not Customer, and therefore benefits us. Clause 13.4's acceptable-use limits (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass) are not field-of-use or competitive restrictions. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
